name: Helpfulness
description: Provides a block for users to leave feedback (was this helpful?).
project_description:
Helpfulness Feedback provides a simple block to gather feedback from the user, similar to answering "was this helpful".

 The provided block will display a simple yes/no radio button with a question if the information on the website was useful. Upon selection of the radio button a section with a text area will expand, so the user can leave additional feedback.

 Features:

 
 The text above and below the comments area can be customized in the configuration page for the block 
 Email notification upon receipt of new feedback 
 
Customization of data displayed in the report of submitted feedbacks:
 
 Name of User 
 Helpfulness Rating 
 Message 
 Base URL 
 System Path 
 Alias 
 Date 
 Time 
 Browser Info 
 
 
 Integration with MOLLOM on D7, on D8 you can use CAPTCHA 
 
 2.x Release: 
 The 2.x release is being actively worked on and maintained. Development on the 7.x release is considered feature complete and won't receive anymore updates, unless they're security related.

 Initial development of this module was sponsored by: 

University of Michigan Health Systems, Public Relations & Marketing Communications
